measurementContract.wallMs: Unchanged: export click through capture, restore, byte preparation, lightweight inventory and actual native disk save. XML validation runs independently after the saved artifact is complete.
measurementContract.observer: Formal final and paired baseline runs have no AX tree/screenshot queries while export is running. Polling for a complete saved synthetic artifact precedes independent XML verification and the final UI receipt read.
measurementContract.frames: requestAnimationFrame intervals, not Long Tasks (WebKit API unavailable). Nested/overlapping stage windows are not additive.
measurementContract.batchDuration: Old batch measures include a mandatory animation-frame wait; new batch measures contain commit, label readiness if needed, geometry/style reading and fragment serialization, and omit cooperative waits between batches. Do not interpret sums as equivalent phase wall durations.
measurementContract.capture: The outer capture function measure includes its finally restoration.
measurementContract.scope: This machine, fixture and observation window; no universal FPS, long-run leak or release/notarized-app claim.
